Grit faulad hai.
Shaant dimaag se zyada taqatwar kuch nahi.
Grit ye jaan'na hai ki tum sangharsh me akelay nahi ho.
Grit milti nahi, build hoti hai.
Shant dimaag ek sharp sword se zyada takatwar hathiyar hai.
Silence ek argument hai jo dusre means se carry hota hai.
Body strength nahi—mind strength count karti.
Saat gir, aath uth.
Jo parinaam se darta hai woh apne saahas ko seemit karta hai.
Khamoshi shaant hai.
Courage dar ka virodh hai, dar par kabja, dar ki kami nahi.
Mehnat rang lati hai.
Courage sabhi gunon ke chadhne ka seedha hai.
Khamoshi ko aagyanta, shaanti ko swikaar, aur daayaluat ko kamzori mat samjho.
World sabko break karta hai; phir kuch broken places pe strong bante.
Himmat greatness ki chingari hai.
Jab sab haar maan lein, tabhi asli grit dikhta hai.
Grit lambi raah se bach kar nikalta.
